captures.title: Aetheria vault editing doctrine
captures.body: The vault should be edited as a coherent worldbuilding knowledge base with RAG-first discovery, direct note reads, preserved wiki links, causal material grounding, and continuity across eras, factions, technologies, and themes.
captures.speaker: repo-state

captures.title: Aetheria site and vault structure
captures.body: The repo owns the Aetheria vault content and Aetheria-specific Quartz overlay while GameCult-Quartz owns the shared engine. Generated output lives under quartz-site/public.
captures.speaker: repo-state

captures.title: Aetheria release path and design stack
captures.body: The current design index names the design stack, systems, release path, and inherited planning documents while warning that older planning maps are design pressure, not current marching orders.
captures.speaker: repo-state

backlog_items.title: Model Aetheria vault topology
backlog_items.summary: Build a source-grounded graph of major vault branches, index notes, wiki-link seams, and publishing boundaries before content edits.

priority.rationale: The first swarm run must understand the vault like a codebase before it can safely propose site or lore changes.

acceptance_sketch: Graph/model candidates name major vault branches, index notes, source refs, and publishing boundaries.
Modeling uses RAG plus direct note reads.

backlog_items.title: Propose first low-risk Aetheria website slice
backlog_items.summary: Use the modeled vault/site state to propose one bounded website objective draft for human adoption.

priority.rationale: A small website slice is low risk and proves the swarm loop without touching Epiphany harness internals.

acceptance_sketch: Objective draft includes includes/excludes, source notes, verification plan, and publishing boundary.

roadmap_streams.title: Aetheria Vault Model
roadmap_streams.purpose: Keep the lore vault queryable as a source tree: branches, links, themes, continuity seams, and publishing boundaries.

roadmap_streams.title: Aetheria Public Site
roadmap_streams.purpose: Turn modeled vault structure into small reviewable website improvements without exposing private material or flattening lore voice.

objective_drafts.title: Model the Aetheria vault before site edits
objective_drafts.summary: Run a first Aetheria swarm pass that uses RAG and direct note reads to model the vault/site topology, then proposes one small website objective draft without editing content yet.

includes: direct reads of cited index notes

acceptance_criteria: The artifact names major vault branches and site seams with source refs.
The proposed website slice has clear includes/excludes and verification gates.
No Markdown/site files outside `.epiphany` are edited.

lane_plan.imagination: shape roadmap streams and the first website objective draft
lane_plan.eyes: query RAG and read returned notes directly
lane_plan.body: model vault topology, wiki-link seams, and site architecture
lane_plan.hands: make no content/site edits until adoption
lane_plan.soul: verify source attribution and no accidental publication boundary breach

risks: The vault has private branches and inherited old planning maps that must not become current truth by accident.
